compiled_state.title: Build dogfood replay harness over seed PRs; ≥3 PRs with ≥1 missed finding
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: Replay harness produces comparison report (visual-evaluator findings vs prior reviewer-findings.json)
- dd-2: Seed-PR selection: last 90 days, ≥1 template/CSS/frontend file change
- dd-3: ≥3 seed PRs show ≥1 missed finding
- dd-4: <3 qualifying PRs → harness reports insufficient-sample (not misleading result)

## Implementation Notes
Create plugins/dso/scripts/dogfood_visual_evaluator.py with:

- discover_seed_prs(merged_since_days: int = 90, min_ui_files: int = 1) -> list[dict]: queries git log for merged PRs touching UI files; returns metadata
- replay_pr(pr_number) -> dict: checks out PR base, runs visual-evaluator (stub mode for tests), compares against prior reviewer-findings.json (loaded from PR comments via gh CLI)
- main(): runs discover → replay → comparison report, asserts ≥3 PRs with ≥1 missed finding, OR reports insufficient-sample

Seed PRs reference: use PRs from this epic (369, 373, 376, 379) as test seed since they're UI-related and recent.

Tests in tests/visual_eval/test_dogfood_harness.py:
- test_discover_filters_by_ui_files_and_recency (90-day window respected)
- test_insufficient_sample_when_too_few_prs (1 qualifying PR → insufficient-sample message)
- test_replay_produces_comparison_report (mock visual-evaluator output → report has findings_new_to_visual_evaluator per PR)
- test_at_least_3_prs_with_missed_finding (mock 3 PRs each with ≥1 finding not in prior review → assertion holds)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] dogfood_visual_evaluator.py exists with required entry points
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/scripts/dogfood_visual_evaluator.py && grep -q 'discover_seed_prs' plugins/dso/scripts/dogfood_visual_evaluator.py
- [ ] 4 regression tests pass
  Verify: pytest tests/visual_eval/test_dogfood_harness.py -v

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet)
